programme.title: PRADA 36th America's Cup
programme.desc: The moment everyone was waiting for has arrived: the 36th America’s Cup has started. Postponed a couple of days due to restrictions, it has finally started with a big start. The defender team started the day with an aggressive start and taking the lead, but Luna Rossa Prada Pirelli came to win this competition. What will happen at the end of this day? Watch the highlights of the competition.

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2017
programme.desc: Welcome to Inside Sailing, the TV program that brings you all the very best action from some of the most spectacular sailing events around the world. Sailing allows us to discover new horizons, challenges, and exciting journeys in some of the most breath-taking sceneries.We will take you on a journey around the globe to find the best sailing spots chosen by nautical enthusiasts. Discover the personalities of the athletes that prepare themselves both physically and mentally to overcome the struggles faced in the upcoming Olympic Games.Sail with Nautical Channel in Inside Sailing around the world.

programme.title: The World Sailing Show
programme.desc: The World Sailing Show is a close up monthly view of the racing world, a global sailing series featuring the very best action from the world of sailing. We travel the world finding out the most important sailing events, interviewing great personalities in the nautical world and discovering the advances and latest additions to the competitive world. Come jump on board with us as we witness the first capsize of an AC75, build up to the summer Olympic Games, make it to the Sydney-Hobart Yacht Race or discover how Francis Joyon and his IDEC Sprots crew broke new records in sailing. Discover the world of sailing, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: America's Cup Insight
programme.desc: When the out-spending was impossible, out-thinking did the job. Emirates Team New Zealand has dominated the 35th America's Cup Match seven to one to become the new Defender. After nearly two decades, the end of both the Alinghi and Oracle Eras is here and the kiwis are back on the top of the world. We will watch the battles, highlights and comments of this historic victory.

programme.title: Heineken Regatta 2015
programme.desc: Get ready to rumble in Simpson Bay where the St. Maarten Heineken Regatta will celebrate its 35th anniversary edition! With the official slogan being Serious Fun, it is no wonder people come from over 25 countries to attend this one of a kind regatta. Given this year's lineup, we are expecting some of the best sailing in St. Maarten. Watch the highlights of the 2015 edition!

programme.title: Clipper: The Race Of Their Lives
programme.desc: Coming up in this week's episode, the crews are ready for an all Australian adventure as they sail coast to coast. On reaching Sydney, they will join the blue riband Sydney Hobart Yacht Race with hundreds of other sailors.. After seeing the New Year in Tasmania, this is the final race of this leg, and they will be racing to the breath-taking Whitsunday islands.

programme.title: International Surfing Association World Championship
programme.desc: An acclaimed competition thanks to the singularity of the longboard, this year’s 2018 ISA World Longboard Championship is back in the races. This year the competition will see 71 athletes from 22 nations surfing for the podium. And thanks to this year’s high-end location in Wanning, China, the championship will be even more exciting. Join us as we watch the best moments of this anticipated event!

programme.title: Baltic Sea Goes Sup
programme.desc: What SUP Baltic Sea?Considered a hidden gem for many years, the Baltic Sea is now a retreat for water sports practitioners. People from different parts of the world and cultures join the mesmerising background of the Baltic Sea to practice surfing, sailing and most importantly of all, SUP!Join the worldwide phenomenon of Standup Paddleboarding (SUP) that originated in Hawaii and has finally reached the Baltic Sea.Now available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Inside Superyachts
programme.desc: Arguably, a superyacht is the most glamorous holiday you can take. Burgess yachts, the largest yacht broker in the world, talks to us about the process of owning and/or chartering your very own yacht.We take a look at just how yachts are marketed and meet with Australian Shipbuilders Silver Yachts, who achieved the amazing feat of getting a Mercedes car onto their Yacht Silver Fast for one of the most epic yachts commercials ever.For those wanting more than a charter, but don’t want to own a boat outright, we introduce them to MAHA Yachts, a brand new concept bridging the gap between Charter and Sales – a unique collaboration with the world leading hotelier Adrian Zecha from Aman Hotels and Feadship.We sign off with one last adventure underwater, exploring the sea with Deep Flight and Rainbow Fish, interviewing Dr. Xin Wu who is helping to pioneer deep water tourism.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Facing Waves
programme.desc: Facing Waves is an exciting and inspiring TV series that follows top paddlers as they discover the cultures, landscapes and adventures of the world's most amazing adventure travel destinations.Showing spectacular paddling by top athletes in the most stunning locations around the globe, Facing Waves goes from the Dominican Republic to a small town in Wales, facing different conditions in every location, immersing in an unforgettable experience. programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​ If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: Sofia
programme.desc: Sofía is a short documentary film about the life of young surfer Sofía De Tomás, Canary Islands’ surf champion. Originally from La Orotava, Tenerife, Sofia tells us through interviews and cinematic shoots about her surfing lifestyle and what inclined her towards the surf world.Sofia balances her time between painting and surfing, and for her painting has a similar effect sometimes as surfing. However, for Sofia, surfing is a sport that traps you, and once you start it, you can’t stop, you want more. It’s something she can’t live without.Live the beauty of the Canary Islands in this short documentary film about this young talent in the surf world. Sofia offers beautiful scenery, heart-warming moments and a strong desire to get on a board yourself and start surfing the world.

programme.title: Sail-Ho !
programme.desc: In this new episode of Sail-Ho we are visiting Dugi Otok, the longest and biggest island of the Zadar archipelago. It is also the 2nd most indented island in all of the Adriatic Sea, with gorgeous beaches and beautiful nature we believe is worth exploring completely. Come join us in this new adventure!

programme.title: Sail-Ho !
programme.desc: Welcome to Sail-Ho Croatia! We're in Rab, the island known by many as the island of love and happiness since Roman times. It has more than 30 sandy beaches, 2500 hours of sunshine and a mouthwatering gastronomy. Come join us and find out why this place is considered a happy place by so many!

programme.title: Kite Masters 2017
programme.desc: In this year's season of Kite Maters we follow the life of Toni Vodisek, an athlete that has everything needed to become a star and win multiple titles. He has already won three World Series events in a row and found himself close to the podium spots at the end of the year. Also we talk with Guy Bridge: a Professional Kite foil rider that tells us what it takes to become one of the best.

programme.title: Kite Masters 2017
programme.desc: We follow one of the most recognizable figures in the kite family: Florian Gruber. We also dive into the equipment of kitesurf and how it has evolved over time.

programme.title: Tidal
programme.desc: Tidal follows the journey of Lisa Beasley. After she suffered a horrible BASE jumping accident, she struggles to return to the ocean, but ends convincing herself to venture back into the water. Lisa’s journey begins with a childhood love of water and sea life. Lucky of surviving the accident, she must now face an immense recovery period that brings her closer to her mother as well as her first love: the sea.As Lisa struggles to find an exercise she can handle, she starts discovering the beauty surrounding Cape Town’s ocean. The tidal pools in particular became very meaningful to Lisa’s recovery, and she must now work to protect them from the harmful historical cleaning protocols that kill the marine life she has come to love.Watch Lisa’s inspirational transformation and realisation of the beauty of the ocean in this impactful documentary that reminds us of the importance of self-recovery and reconnection with the ocean. Available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Cannes Yachting Festival
programme.desc: Welcome to the sunny French Riviera for the 2016 Cannes Yachting Festival, a gathering in the name of luxury and excellence. In this year's edition, more than 200 models will be shown for the first time ever in the world. Let's find out the highlights of this incredible boat show.

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris
programme.desc: By the industry and the financial world as a whole it's considered one of the most important venues in the field. For the passionate French public it's an absolute must to prepare for next year's season on the water. There's just no other place like the Paris Nautic, because France is possibly the greatest boating nation on the planet. Expected in the thousands starting on Saturday December the third until the following weekend, fans will be storming the pavillions of Porte de Versailles looking for the latest innovations and the best possible deal.

programme.title: Inside Superyachts
programme.desc: In the latest episode of Inside Superyachts we interview Ken Freivokh, designer of some of the world’s most iconic yachts and concepts ever. Besides talking to the genius behind some of the best yacht masterpieces we meet with Thirty C leading CGI concept designers.Lastly, we know that no yacht would be complete without a vessel to get you to and from shore. Pascoe Tenders open their doors to us to have a look inside these space-aged, hyperluxurious tenders.

programme.title: Second Life In Scandinavia
programme.desc: Hello from Sweden!We are on our way to the island of Orust. This island lives from boatbuilding, and big companies produce sailing boats here to expand their boats to the entire world. When the economic crisis stroke, demand decreased, thus less boats were ordered. This forced habitants of the small island of Orust to find a new path.Refit has become the new trend in Second Life in Scandinavia. Giving a new life to beautiful yachts, not only the economy is changing, but the local community as well. Lucia will venture into the island of Orust to learn more about the way its population has adapted and how it has become the mecca of boatbuilding.Watch out now, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Poveștile Țestoaselor Ninja

programme.desc: Răufăcătorul care urăște câinii, cunoscut sub numele de Tăiș, ține câinii orașului ostatici! Ce-și dorește el? Ca Ninja Nocturn să se predea! Dar Leo, April și Țestoasele își dau seama că Tăiș ascunde mai multe decât cred.

programme.title: Poveștile Țestoaselor Ninja
programme.desc: Leo devine Ninja Nocturn pentru ultima oară pentru a o învinge pe pisica Tăiș și pe vampirii ei mutanți. Această confruntare e plănuită de cincisprezece ani! Dar ce legătură au toate acestea cu Așchie? Bătălia finală începe!

programme.title: iCarly

programme.title: iCarly

programme.title: Victoria: în lumina reflectoarelor
programme.desc: actrița preferată a lui Cat moare și o convinge pe Tori și pe Jade să o ducă la casa actriței pentru omagii. Între timp, Trina regizează o piesă cu ea însăși, cu Beck, Andre și Robbie. Invitată: Shirley jones.

programme.title: Poveștile Țestoaselor Ninja

programme.title: Poveștile Țestoaselor Ninja
programme.desc: Cu un ultim Mutagen rămas în joc, Mikey îi interoghează pe frații lui Rod, pe răufăcătorii Maude și Todd... amândoi încercând, de asemenea, să pună mâna pe puțin sânge mutant. Va reuși Mikey să-l găsească pe Rod înainte să fie prea târziu?

programme.desc: Lumea mondenă îşi deschide larg uşile şi îi invită în culisele ei pe telespectatorii Prima TV. Moderatorul emisiunii este pregătit să îi descoasă pe invitaţi şi să le afle toate secretele. Exclusivităţi, momente emoţionante, discuţii între prieteni, voie bună şi relaxare!

programme.title: Elisa
programme.desc: Frumoasa Elisa Scalzi, dama de companie a contesei Ristori, se îndrăgosteşte de fiul acesteia, Fabrizio. Din păcate, diferenţa mare de rang şi de avere face imposibilă căsătoria celor doi tineri. Intrigile familiei îi vor pune la încercare pe Elisa şi Fabrizio, care vor trece prin nenumărate aventuri până să-şi găsească fericirea. Dar, în cele din urmă, în ciuda diferenţelor sociale şi a imixtiunilor celor răuvoitori, dragostea va iesi triumfătoare.

programme.title: Sclava Isaura
programme.desc: Remake dupa cunoscuta serie din 1976, serialul se constituie intr-o tumultoasa istorie a vietii sclavei Isaura, o tanara de culoare alba. Nascuta in 1885, la ferma comandantului Almeida din Campos, tanara Isaura este fiica frumoasei sclave Juliana si a administratorului fermei Miguel. Viata Isaurei la ferma devine din ce in ce mai dificila, cand Leoncio, fiul lui Alemida, se intoarce acasa. Acesta se indragosteste nebuneste de Isaura!

programme.title: Declarație de dragoste
programme.desc: „Declarație de dragoste" poate fi considerat unul dintre primele „lovestory-uri" românești. Adrian Păduraru și Teodora Mareș sunt protagoniști, iar Ion Caramitru și Tamara Buciuceanu - în ipostaza faimoșilor profesori Socrate, respectiv Isoscel.

Un format dinamic, rapid şi captivant, 50:50 aduce în prim-plan doi concurenţi care se confruntă într-o competiţie unde fiecare întrebare contează, iar şansele de câştig sunt mereu egale: 50% – 50%. Tot jocul se învârte în jurul numărului 50.

programme.title: Connect
programme.desc: Emisiunea Connect își propune să prezinte săptămânal cele mai noi și interesante gadgeturi, de la cele mai cunoscute telefoane, laptopuri, wearables, aplicații și jocuri, la cele mai inedite proiecte care țin capetele de afiș ale presei de tehnologie din toată lumea.

programme.title: Sănătate cu stil
programme.desc: Prezentatoarea emisiunii aduce în atenţia telespectatorilor o serie întreagă de afecţiuni, cu care se confruntă tot mai mulţi români, şi oferă cele mai bune soluţii şi remedii pentru acestea, cu ajutorul celor mai buni medici din România. Telespectatorii vor afla şi cum pot avea grija cel mai bine de sănătatea lor, cum se pot hrăni sănătos, ce beneficii aduce mişcarea în viaţa lor, cum pot trata cel mai bine afecţiuni de care le este teamă sau ruşine să vorbească, dar şi cum îşi pot asigura o stare de bine cu ajutorul leacurilor din natură, al plantelor care pot face adevărate miracole pentru sănătatea lor.

programme.title: Life & Style cu Maria Andrei
programme.desc: Emisiunea le propune telespectatorilor să redescopere destinații bine cunoscute, dar și rute alternative, să cunoască oameni deosebiți și să le afle poveștile, rețetele gastronomice și produsele locale premiate. Maria Andrei mai aduce în atenția publicului știri pertinente și autentice cu ajutorul unor specialiști respectați, și îi ajută să fie la curent cu ultimele tendințe în domeniul life & style.

programme.title: Nu filmăm să ne amuzăm
programme.desc: Comedie „film in film” in care se satirizeaza moravurile din cinematografia romaneasca. Jean Georgescu joaca propriul rol de maestru al comediei. Autorul scenariului, Paul Everac, nu apare pe genericul filmului, in urma unui conflict cu realizatorul

programme.title: Schimb de mame
programme.desc: Emisiunea "Schimb de mame" aduce în prim plan experienţele inedite trăite de soțiile-mame care au curajul să își schimbe viaţa pentru șapte zile. În fiecare săptămînă, două soții-mame vor face "schimb de vieți", vor avea o familie, prieteni și o slujbă complet noi, într-o localitate și o casa cu totul necunoscute. La final, protagoniștii se vor întâlni pentru a-și împărtăși experienţele trăite în răstimpul celor șapte zile și vor fi premiați.

programme.title: Focus 18
programme.desc: La Focus 18, cel mai important jurnal de ştiri, telespectatorii pot urmări, în fiecare zi, atât materiale în exclusivitate, cât şi rubrici dedicate sau reportaje speciale.

Exclusiv VIP
programme.desc: Lumea mondenă îşi deschide larg uşile şi îi invită în culisele ei pe telespectatorii Prima TV. Moderatorul emisiunii este pregătit să îi descoasă pe invitaţi şi să le afle toate secretele. Exclusivităţi, momente emoţionante, discuţii între prieteni, voie bună şi relaxare!

programme.title: Elisa
programme.desc: Frumoasa Elisa Scalzi, dama de companie a contesei Ristori, se îndrăgosteşte de fiul acesteia, Fabrizio. Din păcate, diferenţa mare de rang şi de avere face imposibilă căsătoria celor doi tineri. Intrigile familiei îi vor pune la încercare pe Elisa şi Fabrizio, care vor trece prin nenumărate aventuri până să-şi găsească fericirea. Dar, în cele din urmă, în ciuda diferenţelor sociale şi a imixtiunilor celor răuvoitori, dragostea va iesi triumfătoare.

programme.title: Sclava Isaura
programme.desc: Remake dupa cunoscuta serie din 1976, serialul se constituie intr-o tumultoasa istorie a vietii sclavei Isaura, o tanara de culoare alba. Nascuta in 1885, la ferma comandantului Almeida din Campos, tanara Isaura este fiica frumoasei sclave Juliana si a administratorului fermei Miguel. Viata Isaurei la ferma devine din ce in ce mai dificila, cand Leoncio, fiul lui Alemida, se intoarce acasa. Acesta se indragosteste nebuneste de Isaura!

programme.title: Cum am cunoscut-o pe mama voastră
programme.desc: How I Met Your Mother este o comedie despre Ted, în general, şi - mai exact - despre cum el s-a îndrăgostit. Totul a început atunci când prietenul cel mai bun al lui Ted, Marshall, aruncă bomba, cum că o va cere de soţie pe actuala prietenă, cu care era de mult timp - o educatoare. În acest moment, Ted realizează că ar fi indicat ca şi el să facă pasul cel mare, lucru ce implică mai întâi să-şi găsească marea iubire. Cel care îl ajută în marea căutare, este prietenul lui, Barney, un burlac convins - cu păreri mereu surprinzătoare şi cu diferite metode de a cunoaşte femei, care nu dau niciodată greş. Când Ted o cunoaşte pe Robin, este sigur că e vorba de dragoste la prima vedere, dar destinul are un cuvânt de spus în ceea ce-l priveşte. Seria este narată prin intermediul flahback-urilor: Ted le povesteşte copiilor săi, cum a cunoscut-o el pe mama lor

În acest moment, Ted realizează că ar fi indicat ca şi el să facă pasul cel mare, lucru ce implică mai întâi să-şi găsească marea iubire. Cel care îl ajută în marea căutare, este prietenul lui, Barney, un burlac convins - cu păreri mereu surprinzătoare şi cu diferite metode de a cunoaşte femei, care nu dau niciodată greş. Când Ted o cunoaşte pe Robin, este sigur că e vorba de dragoste la prima vedere, dar destinul are un cuvânt de spus în ceea ce-l priveşte. Seria este narată prin intermediul flahback-urilor: Ted le povesteşte copiilor săi, cum a cunoscut-o el pe mama lor

programme.title: Unomattina
programme.desc: Il programma della mattina di Rai1 che racconta l'attualità italiana ed estera celebra quest'anno il quarantesimo anniversario della sua nascita. programme.title: Unomattina
programme.desc: Il programma della mattina di Rai1 che racconta l'attualità italiana ed estera celebra quest'anno il quarantesimo anniversario della sua nascita. programme.title: Storie italiane
programme.desc: Eleonora Daniele conduce il programma dedicato ai temi di stretta attualità e ai principali casi di cronaca. In studio storie e protagonisti che raccontano in prima persona le loro esperienze.

programme.title: È sempre mezzogiorno!
programme.desc: Antonella Clerici riapre la cucina più green della televisione italiana e torna con i suoi compagni di È sempre mezzogiorno per un nuovo anno di interviste, giochi e sorprese.

programme.title: La volta buona
programme.desc: Interviste faccia a faccia, spettacolo, musica, tv, cinema, letteratura e attualità, ogni giorno in diretta con Caterina Balivo e i suoi ospiti.

programme.title: Il paradiso delle signore
programme.desc: Un piccolo incidente che riguarda Margherita mette a dura prova la vulnerabilità di Riccardo. Elisa e Cesare vivono un momento romantico ripensando, ognuno per sé, alle foto scattate insieme.

programme.title: Vita in diretta
programme.desc: Alberto Matano conduce il programma di attualità, cronaca e spettacolo del pomeriggio di Rai 1. Collegamenti in diretta con inviati sul territorio, esperti e ospiti in studio per gli approfondimenti sui temi quotidiani di cronaca, attualità e spettacolo.

programme.title: L'Eredità
programme.desc: Il game show di Rai Uno in cui 7 concorrenti si sfidano in diverse prove ad eliminazione, fino ad arrivare alla fase finale del gioco, l'imperdibile Ghigliottina. Qui, il campione della giornata, deve indovinare una parola attraverso le "parole indizio" per vincere.

programme.title: Cinque Minuti
programme.desc: Bruno Vespa racconta l'Italia e il mondo attraverso interviste a personaggi della politica interna e internazionale, del mondo artistico, culturale e dello spettacolo per approfondire le notizie giorno per giorno.

programme.title: Affari tuoi
programme.desc: Stefano De Martino conduce "Affari tuoi": 20 concorrenti, uno per regione d'Italia, sfidano la fortuna e il "Dottore" per trovare il pacco contenente 300.000 euro.

programme.title: Meravigliosamente
programme.desc: Due serate evento su Raiuno vedono, per la prima volta, Sal Da Vinci protagonista di un suo show televisivo. Attraverso le sue canzoni, si racconta la storia di un artista; non mancano momenti di spettacolo con protagonisti del mondo della musica, del cinema, della fiction e dello sport. Sal Da Vinci ci racconta meravigliosamente la sua vita straordinaria, componendo un ritratto originale, in chiave pop, della storia del nostro Paese. Con Sal Da Vinci. Regia di Fabrizio Guttuso Alaimo.

programme.title: Tv7
programme.desc: Settimanale del TG1. Direttore Gian Marco Chiocci.

programme.title: Sottovoce
programme.desc: Gigi Marzullo ripercorre l'itinerario umano, artistico e professionale di personaggi dello sport, dello spettacolo o della cultura.

programme.title: Buongiorno Benessere
programme.desc: RUBRICA - Programma dedicato alla salute, all'informazione medica e all'approfondimento scientifico; si pone l'obiettivo di divulgare temi e argomenti medici con un linguaggio semplice e diretto, di aiutare i telespettatori r - assicurandoli sui piccoli disturbi quotidiani attraverso la voce di medici autorevoli del nostro SSN. Parole d'ordine: prevenzione, corretto stile di vita e benessere a 360 gradi. I telespettatori potranno dialogare con gli esperti in studio scrivendo una mail e ponendo loro delle domande sulla salute, nel pieno spirito del servizio pubblico. - Conduce Vira Carbone

programme.title: Vista Terra
programme.desc: Vista terra. Un viaggio nell'Italia autentica - Le bellezze del Sannio - RUBRICA - Viaggio alla scoperta dell'anima più autentica di ogni regione italiana. Si muove con eleganza divulgativa tra storia, mem - oria ed identità, intrecciando tradizione e contemporaneità in un percorso narrativo unico e coinvolgente. Ogni puntata è un itinerario che fonde paesaggi, gastronomia, mestieri antichi e cultura del territorio. Un linguaggio accessibile e raffinato accompagna lo spettatore in un'esperienza visiva e culturale che celebra la bellezza e la ricchezza dell'Italia più autentica. - Un programma di Gennaro Coppola Condotto da Federico Quaranta Con Diletta Acanfora Prodotto da ZEUS GROUP SRLS Produttori esecutivi per ZEUS GROUP Antonio Palmieri Delegato Rai Milvia Licari Regia di Gennaro Coppola

programme.title: Linea Verde Storie
programme.desc: RUBRICA - Il programma attraversa l'Italia in sei puntate, raccontando territori, paesaggi, mestieri, famiglie e imprese che vivono il cambiamento. Il brand entra non come interruzione, ma come soggetto che legge e int - erpreta le esigenze del Paese reale: protezione della casa, sostegno alle famiglie, vicinanza alle imprese, attenzione ai temi sociali, accompagnamento verso modelli più sostenibili. - Conducono Federico Quaranta e Giulia Capocchi Ideato da Gian Marco Mori Scritto con Fabiana Ruggiero e Massimo Divenuto Una produzione Siri Video Produttore esecutivo per La Siri Video Chiara Delle Chiaie Delegato Rai Milvia Licari Regia di Gian Marco Mori

programme.title: Linea Verde Italia
programme.desc: RUBRICA - In questa puntata andiamo a Reggio Emilia, nelle Terre di Canossa, alla scoperta di un territorio in cui paesaggio, cultura, storia, tradizioni artigiane e innovazione si intrecciano, dando vita a un r - acconto autentico e originale. Tante le esperienze da vivere e condividere: un viaggio attraverso la tutela e la valorizzazione del paesaggio, il patrimonio artistico e culturale, l'economia circolare, le nuove opportunità e le storie di chi ha scelto di cambiare vita, investendo nel territorio e nel futuro. - Conducono Monica Caradonna e Tinto Un programma di Alessandra Curia, Domenico Nucera, Silvia Liberato, Valeria Marrano, Andrea Pasquini, Maria Laura Veneziano, Sabrina Zappetta, Vincenzo Arnone, Maria Agostinelli, Angela Costantino, Domizia Mattei Produttore esecutivo Daniela Rainaldi Regia di Raffaele Cappelli

programme.title: Bar Centrale
programme.desc: RUBRICA - Il programma racconta l'Italia attraverso cinque notizie della settimana, tra costume, spettacolo e società. Ospiti in studio e collegamenti con bar e circoli di paese danno voce alla gente comune, intrecciando attualità e - storie di comunità. La provincia diventa così una lente per comprendere il Paese. Uno specchio dell'Italia più autentica, fatta di relazioni vere, buon senso, e una straordinaria capacità di adattarsi, resistere, immaginare. - Conduce Elisa Isoardi

programme.title: Passaggio a Nord Ovest
programme.desc: DOCUMENTARIO - In questa puntata:- Visitiamo la Valle d'Aosta, una regione ricchissima di meraviglie e bellezze mozzafiato;- Simbolo peculiare dello Sri Lanka, l'Esala Perahera è la più antica e grandiosa festa del paese ch - e anima la città di Kandy in cui si ritrovano buddisti provenienti da tutto il mondo;- A pochi chilometri da Marsiglia, si trova la grotta Cosquer, una cavità semisommersa che il mare custodisce gelosamente da millenni;- Andiamo al Palazzo Reale di Milano, per un viaggio inedito nell'universo di Salvador Dalì. - Un programma di Alberto Angela Con la collaborazione di Vito Lamberti ed Emilio Quinto Produttore esecutivo Emanuela Capo Regia di Silva Verzari

programme.desc: RUBRICA - Il programma di genere della tv dopo il successo dello scorso anno si rinnova ma nel segno della sua identità: il racconto del maschile in tutte le sue sfaccettature, con tante novità. Il programma si arricchisce, infatti, anche del punto di vista di una donna misteriosa diversa per ogni puntata, la cui identità verrà svelata nel corso della trasmissione. programme.title: La famiglia
programme.desc: La famiglia Panini. L'avventura delle figurine 1^ Visione - FICTION - Nel 1940 Antonio e Olga Panini si trasferiscono a Modena con i loro otto figli, decisi a costruirsi una vita più libera. La piccola pro - duzione di sapone avviata dalla famiglia sembra offrire nuove possibilità, ma la guerra mette presto tutto in discussione. Tra difficoltà e perdite, i Panini cercano di andare avanti e di ritrovare una speranza per il futuro. Quando a Veronica si presenta un'occasione inattesa, Olga decide di scommettere su un progetto nuovo. Una vecchia edicola diventa così il punto di partenza di un'avventura destinata a cambiare il destino della famiglia. Con la Liberazione e un'idea ingegnosa, i Panini iniziano a guardare a sogni sempre più grandi. - Regia di Letizia Lamartire Con Serena Rossi, Simone Liberati, Federico Cesari, Benedetta Cimatti, Luca Di Sessa, Samuele Teneggi, Cecilia Bertozzi, Isabella Mottinelli, Elisa Nardini, Adalgisa Manfrida E con Edoardo Pesce E con la partecipazione di Barbora Bobulova Una produzione Indigo Film in collaborazione con Rai Fiction 1^ puntata

programme.title: Il ladro di giorni
programme.desc: Salvo aveva cinque anni quando suo padre Vincenzo è stato arrestato, praticamente davanti ai suoi occhi. Sette anni dopo Salvo vive con gli zii e il cuginetto un'esistenza controllata e tranquilla nel torinese: ma suo padre torna e reclama il figlio per quattro giorni. Vincenzo deve trasportare un carico importante fino a Bari e porta con sé Salvo come assicurazione: un bambino è meglio di una pistola, afferma, perché la sua presenza nel caso di un eventuale fermo di polizia può avere un effetto-distrazione.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: Rose è sempre più sospettosa di Lucian e Constance. La passione invece travolge Alice e Victor Michel, che sulla carta sembra l'uomo perfetto. Cecil e Danioni cercano di convincere Bella a cedere la proprietà dell'hotel al marito, attraverso una legge in realtà abrogata sull'autorizzazione maritale. Ma Bella li spia e capisce il doppio gioco, così si fa aiutare da Albani e Claudine, con l'avvocato Bruzzone, per escogitare un piano.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: All'inaugurazione del casinò, dopo un applaudito numero vocale di Claudine Pascal, Cecil viene imbrogliato da Danioni e Farrino, che in una mano di poker truccata gli sottraggono la proprietà dell'albergo con la complicità di Victor, rivelatosi un truffatore. Mentre proseguono le schermaglie amorose tra Betty, Paola e i due operai, giunge a Constance la notizia che per suo figlio c'è bisogno della sua presenza a Londra e la ragazza decide di partire.

programme.title: Passato e Presente
programme.desc: Il 1898 è l'anno che poteva cambiare per sempre il volto dell'Italia. Il pane costa troppo, la fame spinge le piazze alla rivolta, e a Milano l'esercito spara sulla folla: oltre cento morti, duemila arresti, i giornali d'opposizione chiusi. Il re decora il generale che ha ordinato il massacro. Sembra l'inizio di una deriva autoritaria senza ritorno. Ma è solo l'ultimo atto di una crisi che attraversa tutta l'Europa di fine secolo: le élite liberali si dividono davanti a una domanda drammatica, allargare la partecipazione politica o difendere il potere di pochi? Da una parte Sonnino e Pelloux, che vogliono restituire la guida dello Stato alla Corona; dall'altra Zanardelli e Giolitti, pronti a tutto pur di salvare le prerogative della Camera. E quando tutto sembra deciso, la storia cambia volto: il 29 luglio 1900, a Monza, l'anarchico Gaetano Bresci spara al re Umberto I. Ha voluto vendicare i morti di Milano. Il Paese si ferma, e da quella frattura nasce una stagione nuova. In studio con Paolo Mieli, il prof. Fulvio Cammarano.

programme.title: Report
programme.desc: Il futuro di Gaza tra le macerie della guerra, i progetti di ricostruzione di Donald Trump e gli interessi economici e geopolitici che attraversano la Striscia. La nuova puntata di Report indaga sui finanziamenti e sul ruolo delle comunità palestinesi, mentre resta aperta la questione del controllo del territorio. Dalla crisi mediorientale a Napoli, dove l'arrivo dell'America's Cup modifica i piani di bonifica dell'area di Bagnoli, ancora segnata dall'inquinamento industriale. Spazio poi all'inchiesta di Giulia Innocenzi sulla filiera delle uova, tra allevamenti, stabilimenti di produzione, controlli veterinari e tracciabilità. Infine, il boom delle università telematiche e le indagini della Procura di Napoli sul gruppo Multiversity e sui presunti rapporti tra pubblicità e informazione.

programme.title: Adac 24h Race 2026 - Nurburgring - Start
programme.desc: Testul suprem pentru om si masina: Iadul Verde! 24 de ore! Nicio scapare! Pe parcursul a 25.378 de metri de asfalt nemilos si conditii in continua schimbare, circuitul in sine este un rival implacabil. Adauga la acestea 150 de masini - de la modele GT extrem de rapide pana la modesta Dacia Logan - care lupta pentru glorie in permanenta, si vei obtine un spectacol pur, nefiltrat, de la rasarit pana la apus!

programme.title: Highlights_Ferrari Challenge Europe 2026_Lemans
programme.desc: Ferrari Challenge a fost o parte integranta a lumii curselor timp de peste trei decenii. Astazi, seria monomarca a Calutului Cabrat se desfasoara in cinci regiuni diferite: Europa, America de Nord, Marea Britanie, Japonia si Australasia.Incepand cu 2026, EMPA este mandra sa va ofere intreaga lume a Ferrari Challenge Racing: peste 200 de piloti si aproape 100 de curse in cadrul a aproape 30 de etape - de la Laguna Seca la Silverstone, de la Suzuka la Le Mans!Fii martor la spectacol pe tot parcursul sezonului - din februarie si pana la punctul culminant stralucitor de la Finala Mondiala!

Pentru fiecare pasionat de F1, GP Confidential este o experienta de neratat. Descopera Formula 1 asa cum nu ai mai vazut-o pana acum cu GP Confidential!

programme.title: Australian Boat Racing 2025 - Episodul 4
programme.desc: Bun venit in calendarul Offshore Superboat Championship 2025-26, o competitie spectaculoasa ce va avea loc in unele dintre cele mai pitoresti regiuni ale Australiei. Cu curse intense desfasurate in multiple clase - atat cu cockpit deschis, cat si inchis - Superboat-urile promit viteza, adrenalina si momente memorabile pentru toti pasionatii.

programme.title: Fia Formula 4 Italy 2026 - Race 1 - Misano
programme.desc: Cele mai mari grile - cele mai stralucite talente: acesta este viitorul curselor! Campionatul Italian de Formula 4 este punctul de referinta pentru F4 la nivel mondial, primul pas crucial de la karting catre F1. Cu 40 dintre cei mai promitatori tineri piloti - multi fiind deja integrati in programele pentru juniori ale Formulei 1 - fiecare tur si fiecare batalie reprezinta o demonstratie de ambitie pura, talent si determinare.

programme.title: Highlights_Ferrari Challenge Europe 2026_Mugello
programme.desc: Ferrari Challenge a fost o parte integranta a lumii curselor timp de peste trei decenii. Astazi, seria monomarca a Calutului Cabrat se desfasoara in cinci regiuni diferite: Europa, America de Nord, Marea Britanie, Japonia si Australasia.Incepand cu 2026, EMPA este mandra sa va ofere intreaga lume a Ferrari Challenge Racing: peste 200 de piloti si aproape 100 de curse in cadrul a aproape 30 de etape - de la Laguna Seca la Silverstone, de la Suzuka la Le Mans!Fii martor la spectacol pe tot parcursul sezonului - din februarie si pana la punctul culminant stralucitor de la Finala Mondiala!

programme.title: Fastzone 2026 - Episodul 28
programme.desc: FastZone - Actualizarea saptamanala a motorsportului Actualizarea ta saptamanala despre motorsport este distilata intr-un program de o jumatate de ora. Acoperind totul, de la prototipuri la curse de anduranta, karting la avioane si chiar si unele ciudatenii reale... FastZone combina traditia si o perspectiva proaspata asupra motorsportului, devenind sursa ta suprema pentru tot ce este rapid si fascinant!

programme.title: Gp Confidential 2026 - Episodul 20
programme.desc: GP Confidential - Accesul tau complet in Formula 1 Descopera secretele din spatele strategiilor de succes in F1 cu GP Confidential! In 25 de episoade captivante, imbunatatite cu animatii 3D de ultima generatie, patrundem in detaliile tehnice care determina care echipe triumfa in conformitate cu regulile si care esueaza. Dincolo de aceste analize detaliate, prezentam momente de neuitat din istoria F1 si oferim previzualizari palpitante ale curselor. Pentru fiecare pasionat de F1, GP Confidential este o experienta de neratat. Descopera Formula 1 asa cum nu ai mai vazut-o pana acum cu GP Confidential!

programme.title: Dtm 2026 - Race 1 - Sachsenring
programme.desc: DTM. Aici respira traditia motorsportului. Intrat in cel de-al 42-lea sezon, DTM reprezinta motorsportul pur: combina o fascinatie si o familiaritate unice cu o dinamica inconfundabila!Nu mai putin de noua producatori diferiti (Lamborghini, Ferrari, BMW, Mercedes, Porsche, McLaren, Audi, Ford si Aston Martin) si noua piloti diferiti care intra in ultimul weekend cu sanse la titlu... Diversitatea si echilibrul competitiv transforma fiecare weekend DTM intr-un spectacol!Sustinut de un pachet complet de competitii suport, ce include ADAC GT Masters, GT4 Germany si nu numai - pachetul DTM imbina mostenirea istorica cu o forta remarcabila si un nucleu tanar!

programme.title: Highlights_Psccd26_Imola
programme.desc: Porsche Carrera Racing scoate la iveala tot ce este mai bun din piloti, formand o prezenta globala redutabila in lumea seriilor monomarca. Porsche SIXT Carrera Cup Germania constituie unul dintre cele mai prestigioase campionate monomarca la nivel mondial, noul model 911 fiind introdus pentru anul 2026. Completata de campionatele de iarna Sprint Challenge Southern Europe (ianuarie-februarie) si de nou-infiintata Carrera World Cup din martie -- care reuneste cei mai buni piloti din toate cele 35 de campionate regionale -- aceasta reprezinta apogeul curselor Porsche. Mai mult decat o rampa de lansare pentru talentele emergente, Carrera Cup este, prin natura sa, un camp de lupta captivant.

programme.title: Adac 24h Race 2026 - Nurburgring - Finish
programme.desc: Testul suprem pentru om si masina: Iadul Verde! 24 de ore! Nicio scapare! Pe parcursul a 25.378 de metri de asfalt nemilos si conditii in continua schimbare, circuitul in sine este un rival implacabil. Adauga la acestea 150 de masini - de la modele GT extrem de rapide pana la modesta Dacia Logan - care lupta pentru glorie in permanenta, si vei obtine un spectacol pur, nefiltrat, de la rasarit pana la apus!

programme.title: Adac Gt Masters 2026 - Race 1 - Salzburgring
programme.desc: Piatra de temelie a curselor GT, ADAC GT Masters si-a creat o identitate puternica in universul DTM.Combinand tinere talente dornice sa se afirme cu nume consacrate, totul sub un regulament inteligent si competitiv, GT Masters ofera mixul suprem intre experienta si ambitie - la volanul unor masini GT care scot flacari.Desfasurandu-se alaturi de DTM in cadrul a patru etape, ADAC GT Masters este un element esential pentru acoperirea voastra media din weekend. Viitori campioni si curse spectaculoase pe marea scena a categoriei GT.Ignorati ADAC GT Masters pe propriul risc!

programme.title: Bach - Suite for solo cello - IV. Sarabande
programme.desc: Philippe Herreweghe conducts his Collegium Vocale Gent in this chamber music program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. On the program are Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; Gott der Herr ist Sonn und Schild, BWV 79; and Missa brevis in G major, BWV 236. The soloists are soprano Dorothee Mields, tenor Thomas Hobbs, countertenor Alex Potter, and bass Peter Kooij. The program continues with a fine selection of Bach’s works performed by French lutenist Thomas Dunford. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995; Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007; and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004. This concert was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017.

programme.title: Jenkins: Palladio - I. Allegretto
programme.desc: For this exceptional recital, recorded in 2019 at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées, Camille (cello) and Julie Berthollet (violin) are accompanied by pianist Guillaume Vincent and the Ensemble Appassionato under the direction of Mathieu Herzog. The two musical sisters have chosen a repertoire which crosses genres and eras to explore the expressive palette of the violin and cello, from the baroque of Vivaldi to the jazzy notes of Django Reinhardt and Stéphane Grapelli. Among the works on the program are Brahms Hungarian Dances No. 5 and No. 6, Karl Jenkins' Palladio, 'Theme from Forrest Gump' by Alan Silvestri, Schumann's Piano Quintet, Op. 44, The Red Violin by Corigliano, Hungarian Rhapsody, op. 68 by Popper, Minor Swing by Reinhardt/Grappeli and Csárdás by Monti.

programme.title: Mozart - Gran partita - VII. Finale. Molto Allegro
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita’. The composition is written for twelve winds and double bass and consists of seven parts. The piece’s duration is longer than the composer’s other chamber music works. Remarkably, Mozart chose to use a larger instrumentation. To the eight instruments of the common wind octet, Mozart added two basset horns, two additional horns, and a double bass. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Beethoven - Diabelli Variations Op. 120
programme.desc: Music publisher Anton Diabelli spent most of 1819 collecting money to help families that had lost their sons or fathers in the wars. He wrote a theme, hoping 51 leading composers would be willing to write variations to, with the intention of publishing them all as a set. The proceeds would then of course go to the affected families. One of the composers he approached was Ludwig van Beethoven. Initially, the composer did not want to join, but the idea would not leave his mind. The end result is a set of compositions lasting almost an hour.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano by Corelli, Ravel a.o.
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform an intimate recital recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan. On the program are Arcangelo Corelli’s Violin Sonata in D minor, Op. 5 No. 12, “La Folia”; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op. 24, “Spring”; Manuel de Falla’s 7 Canciones populares españolas; Maurice Ravel’s Sonata for violin and piano; Camille Saint-Saëns’ Introduction and Rondo Capriccioso in A minor, Op. 28; Niccolò Paganini’s Cantabile in D major, Op. 17; and Antonio Bazzini’s Scherzo fantastique, Op. 25, “La Ronde des Lutins”. This performance was recorded on June 22, 2019.

programme.title: Liszt - Elegies No. 1 and 2 (S. 130 & 131)
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Franz Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann. It records the various places where she lived, and the cities she visited as a pianist. This thought-provoking film was directed by Andreas Morell and Magdalena Zieba-Schwind.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Rachmaninov - Suite No. 1, Op. 5 - III. Tears
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart’s Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A; Ravel’s La Valse (arr. for two pianos); Arensky’s Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15; and Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance’ from Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture’ from Nikolai Kapustin’s Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career. Only after WWII, Haskil’s fame began to take off and she finally enjoyed international recognition. She performed as a soloist over the world with the foremost orchestras, and collaborated with acclaimed musicians including Eugène Ysaÿe, George Enescu, and Pablo Casals.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Sonata for Cello, Op. 19
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvořák’s Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". Composed during Dvořák’s stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 1, 9 & 10
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer’s complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 3 in D major, Op. 18 No. 3; String Quartet No. 11 in F minor, Op. 95, “Quartetto Serioso”; and String Quartet No. 8 in E minor, Op. 59, No. 2, "Razumovsky". This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 23, 2020.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, recorded in De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2018. Alvaro Siviero is the soloist in Grieg's Piano Concerto No. 1, and closes his performance with 'Dansa do Índio Branco' by Villa-Lobos. Grieg's Piano Concerto, Op. 16, composed in 1868, was the only concerto the composer completed. It is one of his most popular works and is among the most popular of all piano concertos. It is the composer’s earliest important work, written in Søllerød, Denmark, at the age of 24 years old.

programme.title: Bach - St Matthew Passion, BWV 244
programme.desc: Bach's famous Saint Matthew Passion premiered on Good Friday of 1727 in the St. Thomas Church of Leipzig in Eastern Germany. Since then, it has become essential to the repertoire of Easter compositions. In this 2014 concert from the Grande Auditório Gulbenkian in Lisbon, the Portuguese Gulbenkian Orchestra interprets the work under the baton of Swiss conductor Michel Corboz, accompanied by the wonderful vocalists of the Gulbenkian Choir, and the children's choir Coro Infantil da Universidade de Lisboa. The soloists are Sandrine Piau (soprano), Carlos Mena (counter-tenor), Vincent Lièvre-Picard (evangelist), Christophe Genz (tenor), André Baleiro (Christ) and Peter Harvey (bass).

programme.title: Mahler - Songs on the Death of Children
programme.desc: Mahler's Kindertotenlieder (Songs on the Death of Children) is a deeply personal song cycle for voice and orchestra inspired by Friedrich Rückert's poems about the loss of his children. The work's emotional depth comes from its unflinching portrayal of grief through a powerful juxtaposition of natural imagery and intimate parental pain. Audiences are captivated by the work's profound expression of universal human sorrow and the raw, restrained intensity of Mahler's masterful musical depiction of a parent's pain.

programme.title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Symphony of Psalms
programme.desc: This live performance marks Fabio Luisi’s very first concert with the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in DR Koncerthuset, Copenhagen. Beethoven’s fantastic Eroica symphony is a milestone in classical music, and with Stravinsky’s mighty Symphony of Psalms and Strauss’ virtuosic Don Juan, this production fully demonstrates the unique chemistry between Fabio Luisi and the orchestra of which he today is the celebrated Chief Conductor. This performance was recorded in 2017.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Anthony Ratinov
programme.desc: Pianist Anthony Ratinov (USA, 1997) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed his Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work around the same time as his Symphony No. 6, ‘Pastorale’. Both symphonies saw their premieres in a legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 5 has become one of the best-known compositions in western classical music. It opens with the famous four-note motif, often interpreted as the musical manifestation of ’fate knocking at the door’. This rhythmic figure returns in various guises in the other three movements of the symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Pictures at an Exhibition - IV.
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello). The work is the only concerto which Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. The concert closes with Ravel's beloved orchestration of Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna. At the time, Mozart was busy working on his operas La clemenza di Tito and The Magic Flute. By the time he started on the Requiem, in the fall of that same year, his health was seriously declining. Mozart passed away in December 1791, leaving the Requiem uncompleted. His pupil Franz Xaver Süssmayr completed Mozart’s swan song in the form known today, based on Mozart’s sketches and possibly verbal instructions. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband. This 2017 documentary gives a fascinating account of what happened to one this iconic piece of music right under the nose of the public. Filmmaker Fabien Caux-Lahalle underpins this investigative story with clips of the Boléro in various guises.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky’s tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Berlioz - La damnation de Faust
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust. La damnation de Faust is a work born of the composer’s obsession with Goethe’s legendary tale. Once a righteous scholar, Faust allows himself to be corrupted by the devil, and drags the innocent around him into desperation and death. It’s a fable that defies definition – both a tragedy and dark comedy, with a central character both wise and despicable, and a play and epic poem in one.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 36 'Linz'
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing a charming work by Mozart, with a sentimental connection to the conductor: Symphony No. 36 'Linz is named after the hometown of Welser-Möst. Mozart wrote the piece when stopping over on a trip from Vienna to Salzburg. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in January 2022.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills. In the documentary ‘Hans van Manen – Moving to Music’ (2022), Van Manen reflects on his life, work, and the inspirations behind ballets charged with drama and eroticism. The film features excerpts from some of his most successful ballets, including the then-controversial Metaforen (1965), which featured the first male pas de deux, Adagio Hammerklavier (1973), and Sarcasmen (1981). Film director Reiner E. Moritz also included contributions of friends and colleagues, such as Ted Brandsen (Dutch National Ballet), Martin Schläpfer (Vienna State Ballet), and Van Manen’s partner Henk van Dijk, rounding off the portrait of the great choreographer.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt. Highlights include ‘He’s a pirate/Davy Jones’ from Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man’s Chest; ‘Now We Are Free’ from Gladiator; ‘My Heart Will Go On’ from Titanic; and ‘Shallow’ from A Star Is Born. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 - III. Tempo di menue..
programme.desc: Les Dissonances and leading violinist David Grimal by Symphony No. 8 by Ludwig van Beethoven at the Opéra Dijon in France. Beethoven spent the summer of 1812 in Bohemia, in the spas of Teplitz and Carlsbad. During his stay in Teplitz, he wrote his famous love letter to his "Immortal Beloved ", which inspired Symphony No. 8. The symphony is distinguished by its simplicity and its overall duration, which returns to the classical proportions of Symphony No. 1. Only the finale brings a little extravagance, contrasting with the conventional form of the first three movements in a more modest way that presents an interesting solo treatment of the instruments.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Michelle Candotti
programme.desc: Pianist Michelle Candotti (Italy, 1996) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: Chopin - Introduction & Polonaise, Op. 3
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music. On the program are Ludwig van Beethoven’s 7 variations after "The Magic Flute"; Robert Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 73; Frédéric Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3; ‘Lerchengesang’ (No. 2) from Johannes Brahms’s 4 Gesänge, Op. 70; and ‘Largo’ from Chopin’s Cello Sonata in G minor, Op. 65. This broadcast was recorded on November 12 and 13, 2020, in Geneva, Switzerland.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: A colourful Christmas concert by the South Netherlands Philharmonic with Tchaikovsky’s famous First Piano Concerto. Chief conductor Dmitry Liss showcases, together with master pianist Boris Berezovsky, a true, Russian spirit. In such a way as to evoke what an American critic had said about one of his previous Tchaikovsky interpretations: “Liss expressed an absolute authority over the orchestra and the audience. He displayed a dialogue with eternity”.

programme.title: The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon. In ‘The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres’ they perform music by Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel to a backdrop of high-definition images from the Hubble telescope, NASA and Canadian astronomers. Explore the fusion of arts, science and culture in the 17th and 18th centuries in this imaginative concert commemorating Galileo’s first public demonstration of the telescope. Actor Shaun Smyth narrates a compelling script while the musicians weave in and around a magical stage set by Marshal Pynkoski. Created and scripted by Alison Mackay.

programme.title: Franck - Sonata for violin and piano
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and violinist Maxim Vengerov perform César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press. The conductor's lucidity, efficiency, and lack of pretension, promoted a relaxed collaboration between himself and the orchestra, which is particularly evident in the rehearsal process. This ‘In Rehearsal’ episode features Salonen rehearsing Claude Debussy's Impressionistic orchestral piece La Mer with the Los Angeles Philharmonic at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion of the Music Center of Los Angeles County. It gives a fascinating insight into Salonen’s rapport with his musicians and also into Debussy’s masterpiece.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 1. Op. 1
programme.desc: Piano soloist Boris Berezovsky is accompanied by the Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Alexander Sladkovsky in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto no. 1, Op. 1. Rachmaninov composed his first concerto while studying at the Moscow Conservatory at the age of 18. The concert opens with 'Heavenly Movement', a composition by the young Russian composer Elmir Nizamov (*1986). This concert was recorded at the Tchaikovksy Concert Hall of the Moscow Philharmonic Society on April 28, 2017.

programme.title: Bach-Rachmaninov – Partita No. 3 - II. Gavotte
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight’, followed by Alexander Glazunov’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff’s piano transcription of J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 3 in E major; a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39); Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5); Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7; and Rachmaninoff’s transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Dvořák - Slavonic Dance No. 7, Op. 72
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Antonín Dvořák’s Slavonic Dance No. 7 in C major, Op. 72. Originally written for piano four hands, Dvořák composed sixteen folk dances in 1878 and 1886, published in two sets as Op. 46 and Op. 72 respectively. The Slavonic Dance No. 7 in C major from the second set takes its lively character from a Serbian folk dance, the kolo. This performance was recorded at London’s Barbican Hall on January 6, 2022.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love. The symphony, built on the composer's personal anguish and existential explorations, is characterized by its deep emotional range, intricate orchestration, and epic scale, culminating in a powerful affirmation of human connection in the face of mortality. Deryck Cook completed a version of the work with the help of materials provided by Mahler's widow.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway. Glass’s work, originally a choral piece for the Australian Dance Theatre, was only ever performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Over thirty years later, in 2019, Beacon Isle Films recorded a symphonic arrangement of Glass’s work, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss with soprano Berit Norbakken Solset as the soloist. Their recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten’s spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe’s story. Moreover, this inspiring documentary features a rare interview with Glass.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2, Op. 36
programme.desc: In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt leads the Lucerne Festival Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Piano works by Bruckner
programme.desc: Lithuanian pianist Vadim Chaimovich (*1978) has won several prizes at international piano competitions, such as the Schubert Competition in Dortmund, the William Kapell International Piano Competition in Maryland, and the 29th Masterplayers International Music Competition in Lugano. Moreover, the pianist has performed in several European countries, Japan, and the USA , and has played at many international music festivals. In the current recital, Chaimovich performs piano works by Anton Bruckner. On the program are Klavierstück in E-flat major, WAB 119, Erinnerung in A-flat major, WAB 117, Lancier-Quadrille Nos. 1, 2, 3 & 4 in C major, WAB 120, Steiermärker in G major, WAB 122, Stille Betrachtung an einem Herbstabend ('Quiet meditation on an autumn evening') in F-sharp minor, WAB 123, Fantasie in G major, WAB 118, and Piano sonata in G minor, WAB 243.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 5 in D major, BWV 1050. Remarkably, the harpsichord appears as a solo instrument here, along with the flute and violin, rather than as an accompanying instrument. The piece is therefore considered one of Bach’s very first keyboard concertos.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach’s Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven’s famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 34, KV. 338
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvořák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician. The three-movement symphony features two vibrant outer movements with fanfares and rousing themes, while the quieter second movement is scored for strings alone, deviating from the typical four-movement structure of the time. Next on the program is Dvořák’s Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70, completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák’s broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Cinderella 2008
programme.desc: This stunning, new interpretation of Cinderella, is a theatrical ice dancing performance not to be missed.This story of Cinderella focuses on a humble chorus dancer who is thrust into the spotlight, captivates the heart of the most eligible bachelor in town, and despite rival attempts by her stepsisters to steal his heart, shows viewers that true love always triumphs. Recorded in 2008 in Australia by award winning artistic director Tony Mercer, this twist on the classic tale, features the international Imperial Ice Stars, including Albena Denkova and Maxim Staviski, former world champion ice dancers. Original score composed by Tim Duncan and Edward Barnwell.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Tchaikovsky and others
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of ‘Preludio’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. The program opens with Joseph Haydn’s Concerto in D major for cello and orchestra, H VIIb: 2 (cello and piano reduction), performed by cellist Alejandro Gómez Pareja and pianist Miguel Ángel Ortega Chavaldas. Next, violinist Cecilia Novella Genovés and pianist Alina Artemyeva present Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Souvenir d'un lieu cher, Op. 42, followed by Eugène-Auguste Ysaÿe’s Sonata for solo violin in D minor, Op. 27, No. 3, played by Genovés. Next on the program is Henry Vieuxtemps’s Capriccio, Op. 55, ‘Hommage à Paganini’, presented by violist Mario Carpintero Martín. Bassist Ramsés Martínez Millán and pianist Marharyta Kozlovska close the program with a performance of Johannes Sperger’s Sonata for double bass and viola in D major (in an arrangement for double bass and piano). This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on April 30, 2024.

programme.title: Mikhail Pletnev conducts Rimski-Korsakov
programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music. On the program are Suite for Orchestra after the opera 'The Legend of the Invisible City of Kitezh and the Maiden Fevroniya', and Musical Pictures for Orchestra from the opera 'The Tale of Tsar Saltan'. Part of the latter is the famous 'Flight of the Bumblebee'. This concert was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall of the Russian Philharmonic Society in 2017.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke for Clarinet, Op. 73
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods. The work’s title is derived from one of the composer’s favourite authors’ collection of novellas: E. T. A. Hoffmann’s Fantasiestücke in Callots Manier. Like Schumann’s Davidsbündlertänze, his Fantasiestücke are designed as a musical dialogue between Florestan and Eusebius, representing the duality of his own personality. The former represents the composer’s passionate side, and the latter depicts the dreamer in Schumann. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Martinů - Concertino for Piano Trio and Strings
programme.desc: The Italian-Swiss ensemble Trio des Alpes, consisting of Hana Kotková (violin), Claude Hauri (cello), and Corrado Greco (piano), and the Orchestra da Camera di Mantova join forces in this performance of the Concertino for Piano Trio and String Orchestra, H. 232 by Czech composer Bohuslav Martin (1890-1959). Martin was a prolific composer, creating an oeuvre of almost 400 works. The four-movement Concertino was completed in 1933 and saw its first performance in 1936, by the Basler Kammerorchester under the baton of Paul Sacher. During the years 1931-1943, Martin wrote multiple concertante compositions.
